scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" build && pnpm --filter movynta-desktop typecheck && pnpm --filter movynta-backend typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter movynta-desktop lint && pnpm --filter movynta-backend lint
scripts.check: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" build && pnpm --filter movynta-desktop check && pnpm --filter movynta-backend check
scripts.test:desktop: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" build && pnpm --filter movynta-backend exec tsc -p tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit false --declaration --outDir .test-output && pnpm --filter movynta-desktop exec vitest run
